app.title: Customs
app.tagline: Pack your case. Cross the border. Don't get caught.

orientation.headline: Please hold upright
orientation.body: Customs only inspects in portrait mode.

lobby.headline: Who's travelling?
lobby.tooFewPlayers: Two travellers and one officer — that's not customs, that's a coin toss. Get someone else.

bribery.name: Bribery
bribery.hint: Travellers may openly offer the officer tokens.

sniffer.name: Sniffer dog
sniffer.hint: Waldi gives one reliable hint — at the cost of one opening.

highSeason.name: High season
highSeason.hint: Smuggle up to 10 items, one extra opening.

pack.immunity: You have diplomatic immunity. They don't know.
pack.timeout: Time's up — your case stays clean.

hall.bribeSpeech: I'll give you {amount} to hand out if you don't open mine.
hall.stageDescription: Customs hall with {count} cases on the belt.
hall.stageFailed: The hall could not be loaded.

questions: What's that ticking in your case?
Who at this table is definitely smuggling?
Where are you travelling and why are you lying?

distribute.hint: Tap = +1, long press = −1. Not to yourself.

result.shareHonest: Nobody got past {officer} — then again, nobody was carrying 🛃

rules.headline: Rules
rules.lead: Everyone is a traveller with a suitcase — except one. That one is the customs officer and wants to know what is in those cases. You play with a single phone that gets passed around.

roles.title: Who is who
roles.body: Each round exactly one person is the customs officer, taking turns. Everyone else travels and has a suitcase in their colour.
points: The officer is the only one who taps. Their buttons carry their colour.
The travellers talk — you answer out loud, not on the phone.
After the round the officer changes.

pack.title: 1. Packing
pack.body: The phone goes around. Each traveller sees their case alone and packs {min} to {max} items of contraband. Nobody else sees the number — until the end of the round.
points: {min} is clean: no risk, no loot. That is a real choice, not a fallback.
The more is in there, the more there is to hand out — and the more a bust costs.
What you pack is always silly: rubber ducks, cheese, garden gnomes.

hints.title: 2. The hints
hints.body: Once everyone has packed, the cases roll across the belt. The officer gets {hints} small observations: a case ticks, drips, wobbles, is heavy, springs back. Everyone sees them.
points: A hint is only mostly right. Roughly {truth} in 10 point at a case that really holds something — the rest point at a clean one.
A hint never says how much is inside. A ticking case may hold one item or six. Or nothing.
So a case without a hint is not a clean case. It is only one nobody said anything about.
How many hints there are depends on the number of players: {min_hints} to {max_hints}.

interrogation.title: 3. The interrogation
interrogation.body: For {seconds} seconds the officer may ask anything, and everyone has to answer. This is the heart of the game — this is where people lie, sweat and overdo it.
points: The phone lies in the middle. It only shows the time and a question prompt when the officer runs dry.
Lying is allowed. Including for those carrying nothing.
The officer may end the interrogation at any time.

inspect.title: 4. The inspection
inspect.body: Now the officer opens cases in the scanner — but only a limited number. With {min_players} players it is one, with six it is two, above that three.
points: They tap a case, the image builds up line by line and stalls halfway. Before that nothing is readable — that is on purpose.
Busted: the traveller drinks {caught} sips per item found.
Clean case opened: the officer drinks {harassment} sips. Searching without cause has a price.
An opened case is done. The others stay shut.

gate.title: 5. The border
gate.body: Every case that was not opened crosses the border. Only here does the table see what made it through.
points: Whoever gets contraband through hands out one sip per item — to whoever they like.
Whoever was clean and never opened has won nothing and lost nothing.
If not a single item made it through, the officer gets {bonus_all} sips to hand out.
If they opened only smugglers and no innocent, there is {bonus_instinct} extra sip for good instinct.

modes.title: Extra modes
modes.body: Four switches in the lobby. They are independent and combine freely.
points: Bribery: travellers may openly offer the officer {min_bribe} to {max_bribe} sips. If they accept, the case stays shut — and everyone saw who paid.
Sniffer dog: Waldi sniffs one case. His hint is always right — in exchange the officer opens one case fewer.
Diplomat: one traveller has secret immunity. If their case is opened, nothing happens to them and the officer drinks {diplomat} sips.
High season: up to {max_high} items per case and one more opening. Considerably more goes wrong — in both directions.

end.title: End of the round
end.body: At the end everything is public: every amount, every hint with the truth behind it, and who the diplomat was. Then the next person is the officer.
points: There are no points and no end of game. You stop when you want to stop.
Drinking is always voluntary — water counts.

onboarding.pack: 0 = clean and safe. More = more risk, more loot.

backDialog.headline: Abandon the round?
backDialog.body: The cases will not be inspected.

fatal.headline: Customs is closed
fatal.body: The game could not start. Trying again resets the saved session.
